events.description: Initialization of the 3D star field with a central Sun and rotating camera perspective.
events.clip_query: A 3D field of glowing white stars rotating around a central bright sun

events.description: Sequential drawing of measurement lines from the Sun to stars with dynamic billboard distance labels.
events.clip_query: Lines connecting the center to individual stars with distance labels facing the camera

events.description: Stars transition from solid white to a spectrum of colors based on their color index.
events.clip_query: The white stars in the 3D field change color to shades of blue, white, and red

events.description: Camera returns to 2D, axes fade in, and stars morph into a random 2D scatter plot.
events.clip_query: The 3D star field collapses into a flat 2D scatter plot on coordinate axes

events.description: Stars morph from random positions to sorted by color, and finally into a Hertzsprung-Russell diagram.
events.clip_query: Scatter plot points morphing smoothly to form a Hertzsprung-Russell diagram main sequence
